yahooNews.t: Gavin Williams whiffs 13 in 7 innings and leads Guardians to 6-1 win over Blue Jays
yahooNews.s: Gavin Williams struck out a career-high 13 and allowed just two singles in seven innings, leading the Cleveland Guardians to a 6-1 win on Tuesday night over the Toronto Blue Jays in a matchup of teams in the thick of the AL wild-card race.
